findings.description: crypto.randomUUID() used for all entity IDs instead of branded format (F###, P###, S###)
findings.impact: All created entities have invalid IDs that fail type validation
findings.suggested_fix: Move ID generation to repository layer; query max(id), increment, format with prefix

findings.description: Projects table missing status column defined in ProjectSchema Zod type
findings.suggested_fix: Add status text column with default 'active' + generate migration

findings.description: Learning table schema exists but no learningRepository or learning oRPC router — all 4 ACs NOT_MET
findings.suggested_fix: Create learningRepository with CRUD + findByCategory/findByFeature, create learning router, export from index files

findings.description: No rollback capability for database migrations — AC4 NOT_MET
findings.suggested_fix: Add db:rollback script using drizzle-kit drop + document procedure

findings.description: No TypeScript project references configured — AC3 NOT_MET
findings.impact: Incremental builds not working, slower CI/CD
findings.suggested_fix: Add references array to root tsconfig.json linking all composite packages

findings.description: Drizzle has filename? optional in asset types, Zod FeatureAssetSchema requires filename mandatory
findings.impact: Runtime validation failures when reading features with assets
findings.suggested_fix: Make Zod FeatureAssetSchema.filename optional to match DB reality

findings.description: bulkUpdateStatus validates then updates without transaction wrapping
findings.impact: Concurrent requests can bypass state machine rules

findings.description: bulkUpdateStatus silently skips non-existent feature IDs
findings.impact: Client gets success but some IDs not processed
findings.suggested_fix: Collect missing IDs and throw ORPCError NOT_FOUND

findings.impact: State machine changes require syncing 4 files

turbo.json has check-types and lint but no unified 'check' pipeline per AC1
